title: 完全竞争市场（上）：利润最大化

claims.claim: Price-taking firms operate under many buyers and sellers, homogeneous products, information and relatively free entry and exit.
claims.notes: model assumptions, not a claim that all real markets satisfy them

claims.claim: A price-taking firm has P=MR=AR and chooses an interior profit maximum where P=MC on the increasing MC branch.
claims.notes: checked with the stated cost function

claims.claim: Short-run shutdown occurs below min AVC; losses between min AVC and min ATC can justify continuing production.
TC=32+q^3−6q²+15q; min AVC=6 at q3; min ATC=15 at q4; at P18 q=2+sqrt5 and profit≈12.3607.
claims.notes: shares the hypothetical cost function with chapter 12
